companion.consent.headline.description: Roku (TV screen) headline asking whether to allow a nearby phone or tablet to sign in this Roku. Line break is intentional.

companion.consent.body.description: Roku body text under the consent headline. {server}: the name of the server the nearby device wants to sign in to.

companion.consent.http.description: Roku warning line on the consent screen when the server address uses plain http rather than https.

companion.allow.description: Roku button on the consent screen that approves the nearby phone or tablet's sign-in or setup request.

companion.deny.description: Roku button on the consent screen that refuses the nearby device's request.

companion.reaching.headline.description: Roku headline while the Roku tests which address it can use to contact the server. {server}: the server name. Line break is intentional.

companion.reaching.body.description: Roku body text under the connecting headline, shown while it tries the addresses sent by the phone.

companion.unreachable.headline.description: Roku headline when the server cannot be contacted. {server}: the server name. Line break is intentional.

companion.unreachable.body.description: Roku body text when no connection could be made. {server}: the server name; {address}: the web address the Roku tried.

companion.unreachable.alternate.description: Roku line offering a second known address for the server. {server}: the server name; {alternate}: the other address.

companion.useAlternate.description: Roku button that retries with the server's other address. {alternate}: the host name or address to use.

companion.code.headline.description: Roku headline telling the user to confirm a code on their phone. Line break is intentional.

companion.code.body.description: Roku body text shown above a verification code; the user compares it with the code on their phone or tablet before approving.

companion.code.bodyAccount.description: Roku body text shown above a verification code when the account is known. {account}: the account username; {server}: the server name.

companion.code.match.description: Roku note under the code for older phone apps that show words instead of digits. {words}: the matching words to compare.

companion.failed.headline.description: Roku headline when the phone-assisted sign-in failed or stopped.

companion.failed.denied.description: Roku message when the sign-in was declined on the phone. {server}: the server name.

companion.failed.expired.description: Roku message when the verification code timed out before approval. {server}: the server name.

companion.failed.unreachable.description: Roku message when the Roku cannot reach the server. {server}: the server name.

companion.failed.identity_mismatch.description: Roku error during setup when the address sent by the phone belongs to a different server. {server}: the server name the phone offered.

companion.failed.update_required.description: Roku error shown when the server or the phone app is too old for Roku sign-in. Silo is the app name.

companion.failed.auth_failed.description: Roku generic error when sign-in fails for an unspecified reason. {server}: the server name.

companion.signedIn.headline.description: Roku headline once the sign-in has succeeded, before the phone finishes.

companion.signedIn.body.description: Roku body text after sign-in succeeds while the phone or tablet completes its remaining steps.

companion.signedIn.bodyAccount.description: Roku body text after sign-in succeeds. {account}: the account username; {server}: the server name.

companion.completed.headline.description: Roku headline when phone-assisted sign-in or setup has fully finished.

companion.completed.body.description: Roku body text when sign-in is complete, before the profile picker opens. {server}: the server name.

companion.completed.bodyAccounts.description: Roku body text when several accounts were signed in, before choosing one. Plural counts the signed-in accounts; {count}: that number.

companion.completed.continue.description: Roku button that leaves the completion screen and goes to the profile chooser.

companion.consent.chipSignIn.description: Small status chip at the top of the Roku consent screen saying a nearby phone is signing in this Roku.

companion.consent.chipSetup.description: Small status chip at the top of the Roku consent screen saying a nearby phone is setting up this Roku.

companion.consent.headlineSetup.description: Roku headline asking whether to allow a nearby phone's setup of this Roku. Line break is intentional.

companion.consent.note.description: Roku security note under the consent headline, advising to allow only a sign-in the user started.

companion.consent.noteSetup.description: Roku security note under the consent headline, advising to allow only a setup the user started.

companion.consent.cardNote.description: Roku hint in the side card on the consent screen explaining that a code will appear next.

companion.reaching.chip.description: Small status chip on the Roku screen while it checks which server address works.

companion.linked.chip.description: Small status chip on the Roku screen once the phone or tablet is connected.

companion.linked.headline.description: Roku headline telling the user to carry on with sign-in on their phone. Line break is intentional.

companion.linked.headlineSetup.description: Roku headline telling the user to choose servers on their phone during setup. Line break is intentional.

companion.linked.body.description: Roku body text telling the user to continue on their phone or tablet.

companion.linked.bodySetup.description: Roku body text during setup asking the user to pick, on the phone, which servers this Roku signs in to.

companion.linked.cardTitle.description: Title of the Roku side card pointing the user to their phone.

companion.linked.cardNote.description: Roku side card hint telling the user to approve the sign-in on the phone.

companion.linked.cardNoteSetup.description: Roku side card hint during setup; Continue is a button on the phone app.

companion.preparing.chip.description: Small status chip on the Roku screen while it requests a sign-in code.

companion.preparing.headline.description: Roku headline while a sign-in code is being requested. {server}: the server name. Line break is intentional.

companion.preparing.headlineAccount.description: Roku headline while a code is requested for a known account. {account}: the account username; {server}: the server name. Line break is intentional.

companion.preparing.body.description: Roku body text while the Roku fetches its sign-in code from the server.

companion.reaching.cardNote.description: Roku side card hint while it tries the server addresses supplied by the phone.

companion.unreachable.cardTitle.description: Title of the Roku side card when the server did not respond.

companion.unreachable.cardNote.description: Roku side card hint when none of the addresses sent by the phone could be reached.

companion.code.chip.description: Small status chip on the Roku screen while it waits for the phone to approve the code.

companion.code.cardTitle.description: Title of the Roku side card that displays the sign-in verification code.

companion.failed.headlineSetup.description: Roku headline when phone-assisted setup failed or stopped.

companion.failed.cardTitle.description: Title of the Roku side card on a failed sign-in or setup.

companion.failed.cardNote.description: Roku side card hint on failure. {server}: the server name.

companion.failed.identity_mismatchSignIn.description: Roku error when the phone offered a server other than the one this Roku uses. {server}: the server name the phone offered.

companion.signedIn.cardTitle.description: Title of the Roku side card after a successful sign-in.

companion.chooseLimit.description: Phone/tablet list-heading for choosing accounts; plural counts the sign-ins the TV or Roku can keep. {device}: the name of the TV or Roku being set up; {limit}: the maximum number of sign-ins.

companion.continueCount.description: Phone/tablet Continue button label during TV setup; plural counts the accounts chosen. {count}: the number of selected accounts.

companion.accountSignInAgain.description: Phone label on an account row whose session expired, offering to sign in again on this phone.

companion.accountSignInAgainTablet.description: Tablet label on an account row whose session expired, offering to sign in again on this tablet.

companion.accountThisPhone.description: Phone account row label marking the account as the one signed in on this phone. {account}: the account username.

companion.accountThisTablet.description: Tablet account row label marking the account as the one signed in on this tablet. {account}: the account username.

companion.accountUnnamed.description: Phone/tablet placeholder name for an account with no username in the account chooser.

companion.chooseAccountTitle.description: Phone/tablet title of the picker for a single account to send to an older TV or Roku.

companion.chooseAccountsTitle.description: Phone/tablet title of the picker for selecting multiple accounts to send to the TV.

companion.chooseOnePerServer.description: Phone/tablet note in the account picker that the target keeps only one account per server. {device}: the name of the TV or Roku.

companion.chooseServerTitle.description: Phone/tablet title of the single-select server chooser used when setting up a Roku.

companion.chooseServersBody.description: Phone/tablet lead-in above the server list during TV setup. {device}: the name of the TV or Roku being set up.

companion.chooseServersTitle.description: Phone/tablet title of the multi-select server chooser used when setting up a TV.

companion.close.description: Phone/tablet button that dismisses the nearby TV pairing sheet.

companion.confirmCheck.description: Phone/tablet prompt above a verification code, asking the user to compare it with the TV. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.confirmCheckFor.description: Phone/tablet prompt asking the user to compare a code shown on the TV. {device}: the TV or Roku name; {account}: the account username; {server}: the server name.

companion.confirmCheckForServer.description: Phone/tablet prompt asking the user to compare a code shown on the TV. {device}: the TV or Roku name; {server}: the server name.

companion.confirmNo.description: Phone/tablet button saying the code on the TV does not match, which cancels the approval.

companion.confirmOlderTv.description: Phone/tablet note for older TV apps that show a different code format. {code}: the alternative code or words to compare.

companion.confirmYes.description: Phone/tablet button confirming that the code on the TV matches, which approves the sign-in.

companion.connecting.description: Phone/tablet status text while connecting to the nearby TV.

companion.continue.description: Phone/tablet button to proceed to the next step of TV setup when no accounts are counted.

companion.offerNotNow.description: Phone/tablet button that dismisses the offer to set up a nearby TV.

companion.offerSetupAction.description: Phone/tablet button that starts setting up a nearby TV.

companion.offerSetupBody.description: Phone body text of the nearby TV setup offer. {device}: the name of the TV or Roku.

companion.offerSetupBodyTablet.description: Tablet body text of the nearby TV setup offer. {device}: the name of the TV or Roku.

companion.offerSetupTitle.description: Phone/tablet title of the offer to set up a nearby TV over the local network. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.offerSigninAction.description: Phone/tablet button that starts signing in a nearby TV or Roku.

companion.offerSigninAs.description: Phone/tablet label above the account that will be signed in on the nearby TV.

companion.offerSigninBody.description: Phone/tablet body text of the offer to sign in a nearby TV that is on its sign-in screen. {device}: the TV name, as claimed by the TV.

companion.offerSigninBodyRoku.description: Phone/tablet body text of the offer to sign in a nearby Roku on its sign-in screen. {device}: the Roku name, as claimed by the Roku.

companion.offerSigninTitle.description: Phone/tablet title of the offer to sign in a nearby TV, phrased as a question. {device}: the TV or Roku name; {server}: the server name.

companion.paneTitle.description: Phone/tablet pane title for the nearby Android TV pairing sheet.

companion.paneTitleRoku.description: Phone/tablet pane title for the nearby Roku pairing sheet.

companion.progressApproving.description: Phone or tablet progress line while it approves a TV's sign-in. {server}: the server name; {device}: the TV's name.

companion.progressPosition.description: Phone/tablet progress suffix showing the current step in a series. {label}: the step text; {position}: the current number; {total}: the total number.

companion.progressSignedIn.description: Phone or tablet progress line once the TV is signed in to a server. {server}: the server name.

companion.progressSigningInAccount.description: Phone/tablet progress line while signing in an account on a server. {account}: the account username; {server}: the server name.

companion.progressSigningInServer.description: Phone/tablet progress line while signing in to a server. {server}: the server name.

companion.progressWait.description: Phone/tablet generic progress line asking the user to wait.

companion.progressWaitingCode.description: Phone/tablet progress line while waiting for the TV to display its code. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.setupDoneBody.description: Phone/tablet body text when TV setup succeeded. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.setupDoneTitle.description: Phone/tablet title when TV setup succeeded. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.setupDoneTitleGeneric.description: Phone/tablet title when setup of an Android TV finished, used when the TV name is unknown.

companion.setupDoneTitleGenericRoku.description: Phone/tablet title when setup of a Roku finished, used when the name is unknown.

companion.setupFailedTitle.description: Phone/tablet title when TV setup did not complete.

companion.setupPartialTitle.description: Phone/tablet title when TV setup finished but some servers failed. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.setupProgressAllow.description: Phone progress text prompting the user to accept the setup on the TV. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.setupProgressAllowTablet.description: Tablet progress text prompting the user to accept the setup on the TV. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.setupProgressTitle.description: Phone/tablet title shown while TV setup is in progress.

companion.signinDoneBody.description: Phone/tablet body text when the TV sign-in succeeded. {server}: the server name.

companion.signinDoneTitle.description: Phone or tablet title when the TV sign-in succeeded. {device}: the TV's name.

companion.signinFailedTitle.description: Phone/tablet title when signing in a TV did not complete.

companion.signinProgressAllow.description: Phone/tablet progress text prompting the user to allow the sign-in on the TV. {device}: the TV or Roku name.

companion.signinProgressTitle.description: Phone/tablet title shown while a TV sign-in is in progress.

search.hint.description: Roku search screen: placeholder hint in the text field.

search.filter.all.description: Roku search screen: filter button showing both movies and series.

search.filter.movies.description: Roku search screen: filter button limiting results to movies.

search.filter.series.description: Roku search screen: filter button limiting results to TV series.

search.filterSelected.description: Roku screen reader announcement for the selected search filter. {name}: the filter label, such as Movies.

search.searching.description: Roku search screen: status text while results load.

search.result.description: Roku search screen: result count label. Plural counts the search results; {count}: that number.

search.initial.description: Roku search screen: empty-state title before anything is typed.

search.initialBody.description: Roku search screen: empty-state hint before anything is typed.

search.empty.description: Roku search screen: empty-state title when the search found nothing.

search.emptyBody.description: Roku search screen: hint under the no-results title.

search.error.description: Roku search screen: error title when the search request failed.

search.errorBody.description: Roku search screen: hint under the error title.

states.retry.description: Roku button on error screens that tries the failed action again.

states.refresh.description: Roku button on empty-state screens such as Home and For You that reloads the content.

home.empty.description: Roku Home screen: empty-state title when there is nothing to show.

home.emptyBody.description: Roku Home screen: empty-state hint under the title.

home.timeLeft.description: Roku Home row subtitle for continue-watching items. {time}: the remaining duration, such as 25m.

home.seasonEpisode.description: Roku Home card subtitle for an episode. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number. S and E abbreviate Season and Episode.

home.seasonOnly.description: Roku Home card subtitle for a season. {season}: the season number.

home.episodeOnly.description: Roku Home card subtitle for an episode without a season. {episode}: the episode number.

forYou.recommendations.description: Roku menu item and screen title for personalised recommendations.

forYou.empty.description: Roku For You screen: empty-state title when no recommendations exist.

forYou.emptyBody.description: Roku For You screen: hint under the empty title explaining how recommendations are built.

calendar.filter.following.description: Roku Calendar screen: filter for releases from shows the user follows.

calendar.filter.trending.description: Roku Calendar screen: filter for trending releases.

calendar.filter.all.description: Roku Calendar screen: filter showing every release.

calendar.today.description: Roku Calendar screen: heading label for today's date.

calendar.tomorrow.description: Roku Calendar screen: heading label for tomorrow's date.

calendar.thisWeek.description: Roku Calendar screen: button that jumps back to the current week.

calendar.previousWeek.description: Roku Calendar screen: button that goes to the previous week.

calendar.nextWeek.description: Roku Calendar screen: button that goes to the next week.

calendar.nothingScheduled.description: Roku Calendar screen: text for a day with no releases.

calendar.dayHeading.description: Roku Calendar screen: day heading. {weekday}: the full weekday name; {month}: the month name; {day}: the day number.

calendar.monthYear.description: Roku Calendar screen: month and year header. {month}: the month name; {year}: the four-digit year.

calendar.weekday.1.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 1 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekday.2.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 2 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekday.3.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 3 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekday.4.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 4 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekday.5.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 5 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekday.6.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 6 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekday.7.description: Roku Calendar screen: full name of weekday 7 of the week (1 = Monday).

calendar.weekdayShort.1.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 1 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.weekdayShort.2.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 2 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.weekdayShort.3.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 3 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.weekdayShort.4.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 4 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.weekdayShort.5.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 5 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.weekdayShort.6.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 6 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.weekdayShort.7.description: Roku Calendar screen: short, abbreviated name of weekday 7 (1 = Monday), in a cramped column header.

calendar.month.1.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 1 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.2.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 2 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.3.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 3 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.4.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 4 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.5.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 5 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.6.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 6 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.7.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 7 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.8.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 8 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.9.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 9 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.10.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 10 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.11.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 11 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.month.12.description: Roku Calendar screen: name of month 12 of the year (1 = January) in headings.

calendar.movie.description: Roku Calendar screen: label on a card identifying a movie release.

calendar.season.description: Roku Calendar screen: label for a season on an episode card. {season}: the season number.

calendar.seasonShort.description: Roku Calendar screen: abbreviated season label on a small card. {season}: the season number.

calendar.episodeShort.description: Roku Calendar screen: abbreviated episode label on a small card. {episode}: the episode number.

calendar.badge.series_premiere.description: Roku Calendar screen: short uppercase badge for the first episode of a new series.

calendar.badge.season_premiere.description: Roku Calendar screen: short uppercase badge for the first episode of a new season.

calendar.badge.finale.description: Roku Calendar screen: short uppercase badge for a season or series finale.

calendar.watched.description: Roku Calendar screen: label on an item the user has already watched.

calendar.time12.description: Roku Calendar screen: 12-hour clock time. {hour}: the hour; {minute}: the two-digit minutes; {period}: the AM or PM marker.

calendar.time24.description: Roku Calendar screen: 24-hour clock time. {hour}: the hour; {minute}: the two-digit minutes.

calendar.am.description: Roku Calendar screen: morning marker used in 12-hour times.

calendar.pm.description: Roku Calendar screen: afternoon/evening marker used in 12-hour times.

calendar.empty.following.description: Roku Calendar screen: empty-state title for the Following filter.

calendar.empty.followingBody.description: Roku Calendar screen: empty-state hint for the Following filter; lists what counts as followed.

calendar.empty.trending.description: Roku Calendar screen: empty-state title for the Trending filter.

calendar.empty.trendingBody.description: Roku Calendar screen: empty-state hint for the Trending filter.

calendar.empty.everything.description: Roku Calendar screen: empty-state title for the All filter.

calendar.empty.everythingBody.description: Roku Calendar screen: empty-state hint for the All filter.

shell.signOut.title.description: Roku sign-out confirmation dialog: title when no account name is known. Also used as a settings row label.

shell.signOut.titleNamed.description: Roku sign-out confirmation dialog title phrased as a question. {account}: the account username; {server}: the server name.

shell.signOut.messageAccount.description: Roku sign-out dialog message when other accounts remain on the Roku.

shell.signOut.messageLastAccount.description: Roku sign-out dialog message when this is the last account, so the server is removed. {server}: the server name.

shell.signOut.confirm.description: Roku destructive confirm button in the sign-out dialog; also the remove option in the expired-account dialog.

shell.signOut.cancel.description: Roku cancel button in sign-out and account-removal dialogs.
